summary: This stage executed an extensive, rigorous replication of Paper P in an isolated virtual environment using downloaded MUSE vectors and benchmark datasets. Because 13 precomputed embedding files were missing from the repository, the agent rebuilt the pipeline from first principles, successfully reproducing baseline metrics, direction diagnostics, and the Section 4.4 correlation. Crucially, it uncovered major implementation discrepancies including LinearSVC vs LDA, dot product vs cosine similarity in MWEAT, the 50k vs 200k candidate pool split in Table 2, and the lack of French data in SemEval-2017 Task 2. It evaluated 126 cells against pre-registered tolerances with thorough diagnostics for non-reproducing variants, delivering a well-calibrated verdict of PARTIALLY REPLICATED.
